number.description:
Customer's bank account number 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 20
number.title: number

bank_id.description:
Customer bank's network identification 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 8
bank_id.title: bank_id

private_id.description:
Customer Tax or Legal Entity Id 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 11 or 14
private_id.title: private_id

postal_code.description:
Postal code 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 7 for customer object
postal_code.title: postal_code

id.description:
Unique Id given during initiation to identify the mandate 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil with max length 29
id.title: id

request_id.description:
Unique Id given during initiation to identify request made on the mandate 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil with max lenght 29
request_id.title: request_id

status.description:
Mandate Current Status 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
status.title: status

country_code.description:
Mandate country 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
country_code.title: country_code

frequency.description:
Frequency in which payments are to be processed YEAR = Annual, MNTH = Monthly, QURT = Quarterly, MIAN = Semiannual, WEEK = Weekly, DAIL = Daily, ADHO = Ad hoc, INDA = Intraday, FRTN = Fortnightly & OOFF = One Off 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
frequency.title: frequency

count_per_period.description:
Number of instructions to be created and processed during the specified period 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
count_per_period.title: count_per_period

auto_debit.description:
Specifies whether the direct debit instructions should be automatically re-submitted periodically 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
auto_debit.title: auto_debit

expiry_date_time.description:
Date & Time when the mandate request will get expired (format-YYYYMMDDYhh:mm:ss.000Z where time should be in UTC) 
- This is mandatory parameter for Brazil
expiry_date_time.title: expiry_date_time

start_date.description:
Effective start date for the payment in YYYY-MM-DD format 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
start_date.title: start_date

end_date.description:
Effective end date for the payment in YYYY-MM-DD format 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil
end_date.title: end_date

nature.description:
Mandate nature 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
nature.title: nature

reference_id.description:
Reference Id given by merchant such as contract/document number 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 35
reference_id.title: reference_id

additional_info.description:
Additional information provided by payor 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil with max length 35
additional_info.title: additional_info

currency_code.description:
Currency Code 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
currency_code.title: currency_code

amount.description:
Fixed amount to be collected from the customer's account 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 18 digits including 2 decimals
amount.title: amount

max_amount.description:
Max amount to be collected from customer's account 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 18 digits including 2 decimals
max_amount.title: max_amount

cancellation_requested_by.description:
Party who initiated mandate cancelation 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 15
cancellation_requested_by.title: cancellation_requested_by

reason_code.description:
Reason Code for rejection/cancellation 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 4
reason_code.title: reason_code

description.description:
Description against the status or/and reason code 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 105
description.title: description

audit_trail.description:
Series of events along with date & time stamp on the mandate 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil
audit_trail.title: audit_trail

agreement_number.description:
Agreement number between merchant and customer 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil
agreement_number.title: agreement_number

qr_string.description:
Dynamic QR Code based on the merchant payload request 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil
qr_string.title: qr_string

name.description:
Merchant Name 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil with max length 140
name.title: name

private_id.description:
Merchant Tax or Legal Entity Id 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil with max length 11 or 14
private_id.title: private_id

bank_id.description:
Merchant bank's network identification 
- This parameter is mandatory for Brazil with max length 8
bank_id.title: bank_id

name.description:
Sender Name 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 140
name.title: name

private_id.description:
Sender tax or Legal Entity Id 
- This parameter is optional for Brazil with max length 11 or 14
private_id.title: private_id
